title: Verify Tool Input Schema
description: Input schema for the verify MCP tool that provides deterministic, sandboxed, budget-bounded verification of Lean files and theorems

file.description: Path to the .lean file to verify, relative to the project root

theorem_id.description: Identifier of specific theorem to verify. If provided, only verifies content up to the theorem's end line. If null, verifies entire file.

budget_s.description: Maximum wall-clock time (in seconds) allowed for verification. Hard timeout with process tree kill.

max_log_excerpt_chars.description: Maximum characters to include in stdout/stderr excerpts in response. Keeps response JSON small while providing debugging context.

store_full_logs.description: Whether to store full logs and metadata in artifact directory. If true, creates request.json, result.json, and lean_output.log under {LPAM_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/{run_id}/

workspace_mode.description: Controls workspace isolation strategy. 'worktree' uses git worktree (fast, requires git repo), 'temp' copies project to temp directory (slower, works without git), null auto-detects based on git repository presence.
